title: Teaching model of itsdangerous
audience: A developer who can read Python but is new to the source project
learning_goal: Understand the smallest executable model that connects the public interface of itsdangerous to its core state and correctness rules.

concepts.name: Exc
concepts.summary: Model the responsibilities visible in src/itsdangerous/exc.py: BadData, BadSignature, BadTimeSignature, SignatureExpired, BadHeader, BadPayload

concepts.name: Signer
concepts.summary: Model the responsibilities visible in src/itsdangerous/signer.py: SigningAlgorithm, NoneAlgorithm, _lazy_sha1, HMACAlgorithm, _make_keys_list, Signer

concepts.name: Encoding
concepts.summary: Model the responsibilities visible in src/itsdangerous/encoding.py: want_bytes, base64_encode, base64_decode, int_to_bytes, bytes_to_int

concepts.name: Timed
concepts.summary: Model the responsibilities visible in src/itsdangerous/timed.py: TimestampSigner, TimedSerializer

concepts.name: Serializer
concepts.summary: Model the responsibilities visible in src/itsdangerous/serializer.py: _PDataSerializer, is_text_serializer, Serializer

concepts.name: Url Safe
concepts.summary: Model the responsibilities visible in src/itsdangerous/url_safe.py: URLSafeSerializerMixin, URLSafeSerializer, URLSafeTimedSerializer

omissions: Performance optimizations, platform-specific compatibility layers, and ecosystem breadth are documented rather than reproduced.
The generated project is a teaching model, not a drop-in replacement for the source product.
Behavioral fidelity is provisional because no successful opt-in runtime trace was collected.

output.description: Executable teaching model distilled from itsdangerous

provenance.selection_policy: static importance + import centrality + history hotspots + invariant boost
provenance.portable_case_copy: machine-specific resolved_path normalized after the completed run
